chunks.en: Hi, I have an interview at ten.
accept: Hi, I have an interview at 10.
Hi, I have an interview at ten o'clock.
chunks.note: 到公司櫃台報到時說。at + 時間 = 在幾點。

distractors.text: Hi, I have a interview at ten.
Hi, I have interview at ten.
Hi, I have an interview on ten.

chunks.en: Should I fill anything out first?
accept: Should I fill out anything first?
chunks.note: 等的時候問要不要先填表。fill out = 填寫（表格）。

distractors.text: Should I fill anything first out?
Should I to fill anything out first?
Should I fills anything out first?

chunks.en: Thanks for meeting with me today.
accept: Thank you for meeting with me today.
chunks.note: 面試一開始，先謝謝對方撥空見你。

distractors.text: Thanks for meet with me today.
Thanks for meeting me with today.
Thanks for meeting with I today.

chunks.en: I love it here, and people are so friendly.
chunks.zh: 我很喜歡這裡，大家都好友善。
chunks.note: 被問住得習不習慣時這樣回答。love 比 like 更喜歡。

distractors.text: I love it here, and people is so friendly.
I love here, and people are so friendly.
I love it here, and peoples are so friendly.

chunks.en: I've been in this town since August.
chunks.zh: 我從八月就住在這個鎮上了。
accept: I have been in this town since August.
chunks.note: 現在完成式 have been + since 時間點：從那時到現在一直是這樣。

distractors.text: I've been in this town for August.
I'm in this town since August.
I've been in this town since in August.

chunks.en: I've studied English for many years.
accept: I have studied English for many years.
chunks.note: 現在完成式 have + 過去分詞 + for 一段時間：做了多久，到現在還在做。

distractors.text: I've studied English since many years.
I've study English for many years.
I've studied English for many year.

chunks.en: I answered the phone and wrote emails.
chunks.note: 說以前工作做什麼，用過去式。write 的過去式是 wrote。

distractors.text: I answer the phone and wrote emails.
I answered the phone and writed emails.
I answered phone and wrote emails.

chunks.en: I also took care of orders and planned meetings.
chunks.zh: 我也負責處理訂單和安排會議。
chunks.note: 接著補充其他工作。take care of = 負責處理，took 是過去式。

distractors.text: I also took care orders and planned meetings.
I also taked care of orders and planned meetings.
I also took care of order and planned meetings.

chunks.en: I heard it's a great place to work.
chunks.zh: 我聽說這裡是很棒的工作環境。
accept: I heard it is a great place to work.
chunks.note: 被問為什麼想來這家公司時，先說聽到的好評價。

distractors.text: I heard it's a great place to working.
I heard it's great place to work.
I heard it's a great place work.

chunks.en: I'm looking for a chance to grow.
chunks.zh: 我在找一個可以成長的機會。
accept: I am looking for a chance to grow.
chunks.note: 說自己想要的是成長的機會。look for = 找。

distractors.text: I'm looking a chance to grow.
I'm look for a chance to grow.
I'm looking for a chance to growing.

chunks.en: I'm not the fastest, but I'm very careful.
chunks.zh: 我不是最快的，但我很細心。
accept: I am not the fastest, but I am very careful.
chunks.note: 最高級：the + 形容詞加 -est = 最…的，例如 the fastest 最快的。

distractors.text: I'm not fastest, but I'm very careful.
I'm not the most fast, but I'm very careful.
I'm not the fastest, but I'm very carefull.

chunks.en: My English isn't very strong yet.
accept: My English is not very strong yet.
chunks.note: 被問缺點時老實說。not … yet = 還沒有…，之後會進步。

distractors.text: My English not very strong yet.
My English isn't very strongly yet.
My English aren't very strong yet.

chunks.en: Could I ask about the working hours?
chunks.zh: 可以問一下上班時間嗎？
chunks.note: 面試最後輪到你發問時用。Could I 比 Can I 客氣。

distractors.text: Could I ask the working hours about?
Could I asking about the working hours?
Could I ask about the working hour?

chunks.en: When would you need me to start?
chunks.zh: 您希望我什麼時候開始上班？
chunks.note: 問對方希望你哪天開始上班。would 讓問法更客氣。

distractors.text: When would you need me start?
When would you need I to start?
When you would need me to start?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning! Welcome to Harbor Trading.
scene.zh: 早安！歡迎來到 Harbor Trading。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Hi, I have an interview at ten.
scene.zh: 你好，我十點有面試。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Certainly. I'll tell Ms. Carter, the office manager, that you're here.
scene.zh: 好的，我跟辦公室主管 Carter 小姐說你到了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I hope you don't mind waiting a few minutes.
scene.zh: 可能要麻煩你稍等幾分鐘。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I fill anything out first?
scene.zh: 我需要先填什麼嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, please. Here's a short form. It only takes a minute.
scene.zh: 要喔，麻煩填一下這張表，很短，一下子就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Have a seat. I wish you the best of luck!
scene.zh: 請坐。祝你面試順利！

fills.note: meet with 某人 = 和某人見面。

fills.en: Let me ___ myself. I'm Linda Carter.
fills.zh: 我先自我介紹一下，我是 Linda Carter。
fills.note: Let me 後面接動詞原形。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, I'm Linda Carter. Come on in!
scene.zh: 嗨，我是 Linda Carter。請進！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for meeting with me today.
scene.zh: 謝謝您今天撥空見我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. So, how do you like our town?
scene.zh: 不會。那你覺得我們這個鎮怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I love it here, and people are so friendly.
scene.zh: 我很喜歡這裡，大家都好友善。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well, so are you! That makes a positive impression.
scene.zh: 你也是啊！給人的印象很好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And fall is an especially nice season to be here.
scene.zh: 而且秋天是這裡特別舒服的季節。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let's start with a couple of personal questions.
scene.zh: 我們先從幾個比較個人的問題開始吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: How long have you been in town?
scene.zh: 你搬來鎮上多久了？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've been in this town since August.
scene.zh: 我從八月就住在這個鎮上了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Moving alone is difficult. You must be very independent.
scene.zh: 一個人搬過來不容易。你一定很獨立。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And your English is better than I expected.
scene.zh: 而且你的英文比我想的還好。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've studied English for many years.
scene.zh: 我學英文學了很多年。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It shows. Learning English is a big challenge.
scene.zh: 看得出來。學英文是很大的挑戰。

passages.title: Office Assistant
lines: Answer phones and respond to emails
Good communication skills in English and Chinese

questions.zh: 上班時間是幾點到幾點？

questions.en: What is one task in this job?
questions.zh: 這份工作要做的事之一是什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, tell me about your last job.
scene.zh: 那說說你上一份工作吧。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I answered the phone and wrote emails.
scene.zh: 我接電話、寫 email。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. What else were you responsible for?
scene.zh: 不錯。你還負責哪些事？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I also took care of orders and planned meetings.
scene.zh: 我也負責處理訂單和安排會議。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Here, we respond to every email the same day.
scene.zh: 很好。在這裡，每封 email 我們都當天回覆。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So you have to focus and pay attention to details.
scene.zh: 所以你要很專心，注意細節。

lines.en: Ms. Carter, a candidate called about the office job.
lines.zh: Carter 小姐，有位應徵者打電話來問辦公室的工作。

lines.en: Okay. Tell her we're a small team, just six people.
lines.zh: 好。跟她說我們是小團隊，只有六個人。

lines.en: Sure. And what's the job like?
lines.zh: 好的。那工作內容是什麼？

lines.en: Most of the time, it's phones and orders.
lines.zh: 大部分時間是接電話和處理訂單。

lines.en: Some meetings, too. It takes effort, but it's fun.
lines.zh: 也要安排一些會議。要花點心力，但很有趣。

lines.en: Got it. I'll call her back and suggest a time.
lines.zh: 了解，我回電給她，跟她約個時間。

questions.en: How many people are on the team?
What does the assistant do most?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, why do you want to work here?
scene.zh: 那你為什麼想來這裡工作？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I heard it's a great place to work.
scene.zh: 我聽說這裡是很棒的工作環境。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It is. People here respect each other, and everyone shares in our success.
scene.zh: 沒錯。這裡的人互相尊重，公司有成績，大家都有份。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And what are your goals for the future?
scene.zh: 那你對未來有什麼目標？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm looking for a chance to grow.
scene.zh: 我在找一個可以成長的機會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. I believe this job is a great opportunity for that.
scene.zh: 很好。我相信這份工作會是很好的機會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: A couple of our managers started as assistants.
scene.zh: 我們有幾位主管就是從助理做起的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay. What's your biggest strength? Do you work fast?
scene.zh: 好。你最大的優點是什麼？你做事快嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm not the fastest, but I'm very careful.
scene.zh: 我不是最快的，但我很細心。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's fine, careful is good. Any weak areas?
scene.zh: 沒關係，細心很好。那你有哪方面比較弱嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: My English isn't very strong yet.
scene.zh: 我的英文還不是很好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Don't worry, it'll improve when you use it every day.
scene.zh: 別擔心，每天用就會進步。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The phones get busy here, so there's some stress.
scene.zh: 這裡電話很多，所以會有一點壓力。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But you seem patient. That's a big strength.
scene.zh: 不過你看起來很有耐心，這是很大的優點。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, that's all from me. Any questions?
scene.zh: 好，我這邊問完了。你有什麼問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could I ask about the working hours?
scene.zh: 可以問一下上班時間嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. It's nine to five, Monday to Friday.
scene.zh: 當然。早上九點到下午五點，星期一到星期五。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: When would you need me to start?
scene.zh: 您希望我什麼時候開始上班？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well, we'd like someone who can start immediately.
scene.zh: 嗯，我們希望找能馬上開始的人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But first, I need to discuss it with my team.
scene.zh: 不過我得先跟團隊討論一下。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: In my opinion, attitude matters most. I like yours.
scene.zh: 我覺得態度最重要，而我喜歡你的態度。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning! How can I help you?
scene.zh: 早安！有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Hi, I have an interview at ten.
scene.zh: 你好，我十點有面試。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Ms. Carter will be right out.
scene.zh: 好的，Carter 小姐馬上就出來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi there! Sorry to keep you waiting.
scene.zh: 嗨！不好意思讓你久等了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for meeting with me today.
scene.zh: 謝謝您今天撥空見我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. So, tell me a little about yourself.
scene.zh: 不會。那跟我說說你自己吧。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I've been in this town since August.
scene.zh: 我從八月就住在這個鎮上了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice. And what did you do at your last job?
scene.zh: 不錯。那你上一份工作做什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I answered the phone and wrote emails.
scene.zh: 我接電話、寫 email。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. And what's your reason for applying here?
scene.zh: 很好。那你為什麼會來應徵這裡？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm looking for a chance to grow.
scene.zh: 我在找一個可以成長的機會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I like that attitude. Do you work fast?
scene.zh: 我喜歡這種態度。你做事快嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm not the fastest, but I'm very careful.
scene.zh: 我不是最快的，但我很細心。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. I agree, careful matters more than fast.
scene.zh: 很好。我同意，細心比快更重要。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, any questions for me?
scene.zh: 好，你有什麼想問我的嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: When would you need me to start?
scene.zh: 您希望我什麼時候開始上班？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It depends. I need to discuss it with my team.
scene.zh: 看情況。我得先跟團隊討論一下。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We all wish you the best. Have a nice day!
scene.zh: 我們都祝你一切順利。祝你有美好的一天！
